[TIP] Stand at the town pier on Observatory Knoll and type fish, or fish worms after buying bait at the General Store.
[TIP] Locked crate nearby? Try lockpick crate or lockpick door east -- watchers see a name, not a raw key.
[TIP] Buy ritual chalk at the General Store, then traps paint to chalk a devil's trap on the floor (traps clear to wipe it).
[TIP] Folklore celestial demo? score vitals shows Grace when your character carries the tank (help grace).
[TIP] Someone's map square marked vessel? They may be riding or possessing a host body (help vessel).
[TIP] Hungry townsfolk walk to the General Store or Prairie Inn on their own -- watch Room.Occupants on the map move.
[TIP] Type help planes -- the monster prison is flesh; souls that leave for Earth are not walking bodies.
[TIP] Type help domain -- a claimed pocket is a walkable grid you own; n/s/e/w still move you cell to cell.
[TIP] On the interior map, click a mapped square to walk there; fog or a blocked street only names the room.
